title: 696. Count Binary Substrings

examples.explanation: There are 6 substrings that have equal number of consecutive 1's and 0's: "0011", "01", "1100", "10", "0011", and "01". Notice that some of these substrings repeat and are counted the number of times they occur. Also, "00110011" is not a valid substring because all the 0's (and 1's) are not grouped together.
There are 4 substrings: "10", "01", "10", "01" that have equal number of consecutive 1's and 0's.
